'''Jana Jarel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who fought against the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Jana Jarel was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She crossed paths with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], engaging in a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fight. Jarel managed to wound Garnet in the fight, but he evaded another shot from her.<ref name="RPG" />

==Personality and traits==
Jarel was trained to use a blaster, and was good enough with with the weapon to outgun Garnet in a firefight, although her second shot was dodged by the smuggler.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jana Jarel appeared in an example scenario in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]] of [[West End Games]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] in [[1987]]. The segments she appears in instruct the players and gamemaster how to conduct combat, including which player has the initiative, which rolls take precedence, how to assign difficulty numbers to the shots being taken, and how to dodge incoming fire.<ref name="RPG" />

The unlicensed French roleplaying magazine [[Descartes: Le Supplément 1|''Descartes: Le Supplément 1]], which was published without [[Lucas Licensing]] approval, described Jarel as a [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] of human and the native species of the planet [[Aobys]], for which she was ostracized and forced to expatriate herself. Originally named Samankawin, she took the name [[Jana Jarel]].
